name: Naburareta Onna Sousakan
source:
A maniac story where the heroine's lean body is tormented 
by atrocious men with gut punch, nose hook, kick into belly, 
aphrodisiac, 'low frequency' teasing, whipping etc.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE223427.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一部猎奇故事：女主角纤细的身体遭残暴男人折磨，包括腹部重击、勾鼻、踢腹、媚药、“低频”挑逗、鞭打等。
